info.title: Examance API
info.description:
Privacy-first anonymous exam grading backend.

## Key Security & Architecture Features
- **Zero-Knowledge Encryption**: Student PII, submission scans, and annotations are encrypted client-side (Argon2id + AES-256-GCM) before reaching the server.
- **Session Hygiene**: State stored in HttpOnly cookies (`access_token` 15 min, `refresh_token` 7 days with rotation & reuse detection).
- **Privacy Safeguards**: LaTeX requests redacted in logs (`LaTeXRequest`), IP addresses stored as SHA-256 hashes, k-anonymity (k >= 5) enforced on class stats.
- **LaTeX Engine**: Compilation rendered using sandboxed Tectonic (`tectonic --untrusted`).

post.description: Request a password reset link sent to the user's email address.

schema.title: Response Forgot Password Api V1 Auth Forgot Password Post

post.description: Set a new password using a valid single-use reset token.

schema.title: Response Reset Password Api V1 Auth Reset Password Post

post.description:
Verify credentials, set httpOnly access + refresh cookies.

Response body contains only { email, role } — never the token value.

Issue new access + refresh cookies, revoke the old refresh token.

Detects concurrent use (token theft) if the token is already revoked.
Clear auth cookies and revoke refresh token.

Compile LaTeX source to PDF via Tectonic.

Attached resource files (images, PDFs, data files) travel inline as base64
and exist only for this compilation — they are written into the temp
working directory and deleted with it.

Rate limited: 10 req/min per IP.
Body limit: BODY_LIMIT_COMPILE (enforced by BodyLimitMiddleware).
LaTeX source is NEVER logged — see LaTeXRequest.__repr__ and latex service.
The 422 detail carries only TeX diagnostics, never raw engine or log output.

post.description: Create a new exercise in the teacher's library.

patch.description: Update group metadata and cascade it to every member variant.

get.description: Get an exercise from the library (own exercises or published ones).

patch.description: Update a library exercise in place.

delete.description:
Delete an exercise from the caller's own library.

Idempotent: always 204, whether or not a row was removed. Only exercises
owned by *teacher* are ever deleted, so a foreign id is a silent no-op —
which also keeps the response from revealing that the id exists.

post.description: Create a new corrected version of an existing exercise (archives previous version).
Create a new parallel variant (e.g. Möbel/Fahrzeug/Wildtier) under the same group.

get.description:
Get count and details of non-deleted exams referencing this exercise.

Only the caller's own exams are reported, so usage of a published exercise
in another teacher's exam is never disclosed.
List an exercise's resource files (metadata only, no bytes).

schema.title: Response List Exercise Resources Api V1 Exercises  Exercise Id  Resources Get

post.description:
Attach a file to an exercise. Uploading an existing filename replaces it.

The filename is sanitised and checked against the bundled LaTeX assets by
the schema; SVG is refused there with a convert-to-PDF hint.

get.description:
Return a resource's raw bytes.

Only png/jpeg/pdf are served under their own media type; anything else is
an opaque download. A stored text/html file returned inline from the API
origin would be stored XSS, so the type is never taken at face value and
sniffing is disabled.

patch.description: Rename a resource file (the LaTeX source must be updated by the caller).

post.description: Upload encrypted student identity ciphertext. Handles upsert for duplicate pseudonym_hmac.

delete.description:
GDPR Art. 17 Erasure — hard delete student identity + cascade submissions.
Appends an immutable audit log entry.

get.description: Download encrypted scan submission by ID.

post.description:
Create a teacher/admin account without a password (Admin only).

Generates and emails a single-use password set token to the user.

Trigger an admin-forced password reset for an existing user (Admin only).

Generates and emails a single-use password reset token. The user's existing
password remains active until they set a new password via the link.

get.description:
Get class statistics for an exam with server-side k≥5 anonymity enforcement.

If count < 5, score details (mean, std_dev) are suppressed to protect privacy.

schema.title: Response List Audit Logs Api V1 Admin Audit Get

post.description:
Soft-delete all student identities and scan submissions belonging to the current teacher
with a 7-day retention grace period before hard deletion.

LaTeX exercise templates and exam structures remain intact — including the
resource files attached to exercises, which are teacher-authored content,
not student data. A file that does contain personal data (e.g. a photo of a
pupil) has to be deleted with the exercise or the file itself.

schema.title: Response Purge Server Student Data Api V1 User Purge Server Student Data Post

post.description:
Restore soft-deleted student identities and scan submissions for the current teacher
if they are within the 7-day retention grace period.

schema.title: Response Restore Server Data Api V1 User Restore Server Data Post

get.description:
GDPR Art. 15/20 — machine-readable copy of the account holder's own data.

Covers only what the server holds *about the teacher*: account fields, the
exams they authored, and their audit trail. Student payloads are deliberately
excluded — they are encrypted with a key the server never has, and they are
not the teacher's personal data. Use the client-side per-student export for
a student's Art. 15 request.

schema.title: Response Export Own Data Api V1 User Me Export Get

delete.description:
GDPR Art. 17 — erase the account holder's own account and authored content.

Student identities and submissions under the teacher's exams are soft-deleted
with the standard grace period and erased by the retention job, matching
`purge-server-student-data`.

Audit rows are kept, with `teacher_id` nulled by the FK's ON DELETE SET NULL
and the email snapshot left in place: Art. 17(3)(b) permits retaining what is
needed for a legal obligation, and the trail exists to evidence lawful
handling of student data. Those rows age out under AUDIT_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
rather than living forever.

schema.title: Response Delete Own Account Api V1 User Me Delete

LaTeXResource.title: LaTeXResource
LaTeXResource.description:
One file to place next to main.tex for this compilation only.

Nothing here is persisted: the bytes live in the temp working directory and
are removed with it. Teachers in all-local mode keep the only durable copy.
